pro_course_detail.title: Job interview & application preparation /Business English skills builder - get that job interview or improve your Business English skills
pro_course_detail.description:
In this course, I will play the role of the interviewer and I will make sure to give you a very tough job interview (so that you are very well prepared for real interviews).  I can give you advice on both the English involved in your answer and on the content of your answers. We can also look at professional e-mails, presentations etc, as well as application forms, CVs, motivation letters etc.

Or.. we can follow a general Business English skills course as follows;

a) Follow a programme of instruction based on the Business Partnership courses by Pearson.  These build critical skills in Business English and are available at different levels of English.

b) Help you prepare, specifically, for your business meetings or presentations etc by role-playing these scenarios.  This means you will have to know about a future meeting or presentation that you have to do and give me lots of details so that I can play the role of your audience for your presentation or the people that you are doing businesw with in your meeting!

pro_course_detail.title: Grammar and Conversation!!
pro_course_detail.description: On this grammar based course, the lessons are conversational but we focus on helping you identify grammatical errors in your speech, which in turn will help you to build your grammatical knowledge in English.  Wheras the ordinary conversation lessons focus mainly on building fluency, in this grammar and conversation class, special attention is paid to grammatical errors.  This means that, at times, the conversation may be stopped to provide some detailed grammatical explanation and some grammatical exercises might either be done in class or provided for homework, based on whatever issues with grammar you show in your speaking.

pro_course_detail.title: Challenge your English (advanced) - Learn to use new expressions, including phrasal verbs and idiomatic language, ideal for students looking to improve vocabulary for exams like IELTS, CAE OR CPE
pro_course_detail.description: Are you stuck at a B2 level of English and want to make the leap to C1? Are you at C1 and want to jump up to the heights of C2?  This is the course for you! The classes are conversation based but they are structured in such a way as to introduce - each week - the range of phrasal verbs, collocations and idiomatic ways of speaking that differentiate a native or expert English speaker from somebody who is merely good at English.  By practising using new expressions in natural conversations, this will help you to fix these expressions in your mind (so you can remember them).  Sometimes we will also look at expressions that you know passively (you know what they mean when reading or listening) but you will learn to use them actively (when speaking or writing).

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS, FCE, CAE CPE  or TOEFL exam writing intensive package course
pro_course_detail.description:
If you need to prepare quickly for the written sections of one of these exams, this new course is the course for you!

Warning:  You will need to work HARD.  The course is a ten-lesson package and you should aim to write two essays for each lesson - so you will do 20 pieces of writing in total.  I will give you the essays.

Method: All essays will be reviewed LIVE in class.  This means that you will be an active participant in making some corrections to your own work (with help from me) and in discussing the ideas that you have used in your writing so that we can help develop them.


If you want a trial of this course, then you may book a single one hour lesson to start with.  Otherwise? Please book the package.

I have followed the Common Core standards for science and math tuition in that time for K1-6.

I teach a mix of science theory with games activities and practical experiments.  Science is a great way to learn English and a great way to learn skills like persistence, accuracy, and teamwork. As well as scientific knowledge, of course.

Why study science?

Students can study science because they want to learn it for school, because it's interesting, fun or because they want a practical way to learn English.

pro_course_detail.title: Grammar from ground to growing
pro_course_detail.description:
What you can expect

Using a book of your choice, online materials, or one of my preferred texts (Let’s Go, Journeys, National Geographic, Wonders) we will go from start to finish in English grammar, vocabulary, reading and writing. We’ll have a class together to learn some new words and a new grammar pattern, then practice a bit of reading and writing when you’re ready.  I’ll give worksheets, quizzes, homework and feedback, whatever you need to succeed.  

Why I’m the person to pick for the job 

I’m a qualified TELF teacher with over 11 years experience teaching and tutoring students in English.  I have taught English to young learners every day, including weekends all that time.  No one who completes me classes leaves without being an exceptional user of English. 

Why study this class

This is a great class if you know zero, or a little, English and you want to spend some time becoming great at it.  I recommend taking as many classes a week as you can that way you’ll really see the progress that you’ve made.

pro_course_detail.title: Reading and Writing Excellence Achieved
pro_course_detail.description:
What we will do: 

One of the best ways to learn English is to read a lot and write a lot.  In fact, a lot of grammar exercises and memorization can be thrown in the trash and replaced with widely reading and then writing in reaction to that reading.  In this course we will pick reading materials at an appropriate level for you and then write responses to that reading.  We will learn how to write academic essay and fictional texts.  We will learn how to structure them and along the way we’ll learn vocabulary and grammar patters as we need them.  

Why you should pick me

I have been teaching English writing and reading for over ten years.  My current grade 4 ESL students can write expository essays, descriptive essays, debate essays and opionon essays.  All of them can structure arguments, use achademic writing and write accurately. They also also use figurative language in their pieces of fiction.  They can vividly describe characters and settings using complex words and structure their writing in a coherent way.  I have written material to use in both writing and reading and adapt materials for your needs.

There a skill to passing these kinds of tests and, once you know it, you'll find it's pretty easy to get the grade you need.

pro_course_detail.title: Chess - from pawn to knight
pro_course_detail.description:
Why take this Course?

Chess is a game that teaches deep thinking and concentration.  As a child of 11, I had to train to sit quietly in thought for 3 or 4 hours without talking or playing.  It's a great way to teach the kind of focus that children need in the internet age or for adults to relax and enjoy a new hobby.  I have played chess with Georgians in the museum of military glory, beaten the local Armenians in LA, and played against Americans in a park in Tainan.  It's a great way to socialize and to learn. 

What we will do

The course will be designed to fit your individual needs. It mixes practical play, with advice about your games and training exercises.  Using Lichess, chess.com, and google docs, lessons can be focused on the basics, or more advanced skills.  

Why Pick me as your teacher?

I have over ten years of experience as a teacher and throughout this time I have taught chess in small groups, online, and 1 on 1.  I was a 'class c' British chess champion, and have played for my county, university, club, and in countless tournaments across the country.
